name: arthflow
description: ArthFlow - a simple personal finance tracker built with React, Express and Cloudflare D1

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
